name: Font-Romeu
description: 115km of pistes, 28 lifts, across Font-Romeu, Bolquère, and Les Angles in the Cerdagne/Cerdanya region. One of the oldest ski resorts in France and the oldest in the Pyrenees. Known for: 300+ sunny days per year (the sunniest resort in France), the world's largest solar furnace at Odeillo (3,500°C), and the National Altitude Training Centre (Olympic athletes). The Yellow Train historic railway from Villefranche-de-Conflent to Latour-de-Carol.
